what: Given a MAPPO u0 checkpoint (accel_learner schema, extended for v2v with zero-initialised inputs via the registered v2v_model.load_checkpoint), a bank of pairs (replay_bank.bank_pairs, v2v partner features attached per pair) and the training options, runs ONE imitation phase offline - the registered bank_imitation.run loop, no PPO update, no SUMO - and reports: passes completed; final joint KL vs the frozen pre-update policy (runner's registered limit 0.045, imported, never re-stated); imitation L1 error on the COOPERATIVE pairs before/after with a pair-cluster bootstrap 95% CI on the per-member-step fall (10000 resamples, seed 20261101 - same estimator family as replay_bank._boot_ci); per cooperative entry the fraction of CAV-steps whose action moved toward the plan action; and whether the zero-initialised v2v ACTOR input weights moved (non-zero) - i.e. the policy can use partner intent. Cooperative entries are the bank's own record (summary entries/durations + exposure, with the structural len(proposal_members)>1 definitional fallback).

PASS_iff: no registered KL stop and final joint KL <= the runner's kl_limit (0.045)
cooperative-pair error falls: the bootstrap 95% CI of the per-member-step fall is entirely below 0 (upper bound < 0); CI is None (insufficient clusters) => FAIL
v2v actor input columns non-zero (imitation trains the actor only; critic movement reported but not required)

options.v2v: default OFF (hard rule kept); with --v2v the policy is widened by V2V_DIM=24 zero-init inputs; flag off => GatePolicy is byte-identical to the registered base forward (pinned by test)
options.bank_filter: REGISTERED VALUE 'statistical' - LIVE (BANKFILT_READY.json consumed; branch c4/bank-stat-filter merged at 04087246/58894b86). Applied per entry INSIDE replay_bank.bank_pairs (replicated-advantage + paired per-vehicle deficit bounds); the gate validates the value and discloses summary['bank_filter']. Cannot be applied to a bare pairs file (the rule needs recorded receipts/traces) - the gate raises instead of silently skipping.
options.imitation_trust: REGISTERED VALUE 'own_pass' - LIVE (IMITFIX_READY.json consumed; branch c4/imit-fullpass merged at 58894b86). Forwarded to bank_imitation.run by parameter name together with the bank's summary['pair_cooperative'] flags when they align with the pairs (cooperative-first guaranteed first pass, projected-KL lr-halving).
